name: Oku-sama wa S-Jou ~Fun! Konna Koto Sarete Yorokobu Nante Anata tte Hontou ni Saitei no Otoko no Kuzu ne! Shikatanai Kara Motto Ijimete A-ge-ru♪~
original_name: 奥様はS嬢～フン！こんなことされて悦ぶなんてあなたって本当に最低の男のクズね！仕方ないからもっとイヂメて あ・げ・る♪～
source:
Although his father is the CEO of a large corporation, Tsukasa Ichijo sees himself as a chump with an average academic record at best, unfit to inherit the family business. As a result, he keeps his distance from his father and prefers to work at an average, unaffiliated company instead.

One day, Tsukasa gets a call.

"I'm getting on in my years and my health isn't what it used to be. I need you to come back here and take the reins. I'll see to it you find a wife, too, so you can settle down and start a family of your own."

Tsukasa is reluctant to answer, but his father has never been one to back down.

"I've sent you some potential candidates. All of them are the daughters of prestigious conglomerates and big business families. I want you to get acquainted with them and become a stronger man…"

Tsukasa's father hangs up the phone.

"I understood what he meant about starting a family, but what was all that about being a 'stronger man?'"

Before long, three beautiful women show up at Tsukasa's door. But with each of them showing a strong penchant for "domination," he soon learns exactly what his father had in mind...

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/okusamahaesujoufunkonnakoto-ja/]Johren[/url]]
translation:
尽管父亲是大型企业的首席执行官，一条司却认为自己只是个庸才，学习成绩也不过平平，根本不适合继承家业。因此，他与父亲保持距离，宁愿在一家普通、没有关联的公司工作。

一天，司接到一通电话。

“我年纪大了，身体也不如从前。你得回来接手公司。我还会替你找个妻子，让你安定下来，建立自己的家庭。”

司不愿答应，但父亲从来不是会轻易让步的人。

“我已经给你送去了几位候选人。她们全是名门财阀和商业世家的千金。我希望你和她们熟悉起来，成为一个更强大的男人…”

父亲挂断了电话。

“建立家庭的意思我倒明白，可所谓‘更强大的男人’又是怎么回事？”

不久，三名美女来到司的门前。但她们每个人都有强烈的“支配”嗜好，司很快便明白了父亲的真正用意…
